faqs.question: Help me use MAX AI
faqs.answer:
I'm glad you're here! You can ask me anything about Abdul Samad:

• "Who is Abdul Samad?"
• "What are his skills?"
• "Show his projects"
• "Tell me about his education"
• "What are his certificates?"
• "How can I contact him?"

Just type your question below and press Enter!

faqs.question: Is this AI private?
faqs.answer: Yes — MAX AI runs entirely in your browser from a local knowledge base. No questions, messages or data are sent to any server or third party. Your conversations never leave your device.

faqs.question: Does MAX AI work offline?
faqs.answer: Yes — once the knowledge base file is loaded, MAX AI answers instantly from local data with no network requests. It's fast, private and always available.

faqs.question: Who made this website?
faqs.answer: Abdul Samad designed and developed this entire website himself — server, design, content and the MAX AI assistant. It's one of his proudest projects.

faqs.question: Can I give feedback?
faqs.answer: Of course! Abdul welcomes feedback, suggestions and ideas. Email him at mr.abdulsamadabdullah@gmail.com or use the contact form on this website.

faqs.question: I found a bug on the website
faqs.answer: Thanks for reporting! Please email Abdul at mr.abdulsamadabdullah@gmail.com with the page, what you did, and what happened. Or open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/MrAbdulSamadDEV

faqs.question: Can I use your code?
faqs.answer: This portfolio is released under the MIT License — you're welcome to learn from it, adapt it and build your own. Check the LICENSE file in the repository.

faqs.question: What version is this website?
faqs.answer: This portfolio is at version 1.0.0 — a premium production build with SSR, the MAX AI assistant and full SEO support.

faqs.question: What time is it?
faqs.answer: My knowledge base doesn't track the clock, but Abdul is in Pakistan Standard Time (UTC+5). If you need a call, he'll confirm the right time with you.

faqs.question: What's the weather like?
faqs.answer: I don't track weather, but Abdul lives in Karachi, Pakistan — a warm coastal city with hot summers and mild winters.

faqs.question: What developer tools do you recommend?
faqs.answer: Abdul's top recommendations: VS Code for editing, Git and GitHub for version control, Chrome DevTools for debugging, the OpenCode CLI for AI-assisted coding, and MongoDB for data.

faqs.question: Is the source of this website public?
faqs.answer: Yes — the codebase is available on GitHub: https://github.com/MrAbdulSamadDEV. You can explore the architecture, server and client code, and even the knowledge base powering me.

faqs.question: Do you have a personality?
faqs.answer: I try my best! I'm friendly, helpful and a little playful — but my real job is answering your questions about Abdul Samad accurately and fast.

faqs.question: What questions can't you answer?
faqs.answer: I can answer everything about Abdul Samad's portfolio — but I can't answer questions about other topics, current events or things outside his knowledge base. Ask me anything about him!

faqs.question: What should I look at first?
faqs.answer: Start with the About section to learn who Abdul is, then Skills, then his flagship project Furnecher in the Projects section. And if you like what you see, head to Contact!

faqs.question: How do I navigate this website?
faqs.answer: Use the navigation on the left: Home, About, Skills, Projects, Contact — and the MAX AI button to chat with me! On mobile, tap the menu icon in the corner.

faqs.question: Goodbye
faqs.answer: Goodbye! Thanks for visiting Abdul Samad's portfolio. If you have more questions later, MAX AI is always here — and don't forget to check his projects!

faqs.question: Do you understand me?
faqs.answer: I understand questions about Abdul Samad best! Try asking about his projects, skills, education or contact details — I'll do my best to answer instantly.
